name: Type only
source: A film in which type is the only actor: one to four words per beat, full-frame crops, word-per-shot cuts, in-place word swaps, a rolling word drum and a sentence ladder, usually riding a voice-over. Described from the reference reels' kinetic-type entries; no files are carried.

frame_device.what: A full-frame colour field and one typeface; the repeated phrase spine (a refrain) holds the same place in the frame while the words around it change.
frame_device.moves: Words cut, swap in place, roll past a window or crop to a letter; the colour of the field flips on the beat; a repeat of the spine returns with a new word or a new moment.

ground_motion: The field breathes by 1 to 2 percent in tone and the type holds a slow 1 to 2 percent scale creep between cuts; nothing sits dead for more than 0.6 s.

type.classes: One heavy display face (grotesk, serif or condensed) at 60 to 100 percent of the frame width for hero words, and one small support size for qualifiers; 1 to 4 words per beat.
type.behaviour: Hero words fill the frame and may be cropped by it while moving, but every word is whole and readable at rest; swaps happen in place and the line width follows; words land on the voice-over's word timings.

image.treatment: No imagery by default: colour, type and at most one graphic mark; if a picture is needed it sits inside a letter or a cut-out as a mask.
image.behaviour: Colour flips are hard cuts on the beat; masks and crops are the only transitions between ideas.

transitions: hard cut with a colour flip on the beat
full-frame crop push into a letter, next word emerges from it
word swap in place (the line holds, one word changes)
word drum roll to the next word
mask reveal up from the baseline

techniques.name: Word per shot
techniques.what: Each word is its own full-frame shot on a hard cut, the colours cycling.
techniques.route: RasanTypeOnly.wordPerShot(tl, stage, words, {at, per: 0.4, font, bg: [...], ink: [...], fill: 0.9}); per = the voice's word time.

techniques.name: Full-frame crop
techniques.what: A word is pushed into until a single letter fills the frame.
techniques.route: RasanTypeOnly.crop(tl, el, {at, duration: 1.4, from: 1, to: 2.4, focus: [0.15, 0.5]}); the next shot starts inside the letter's counter.

techniques.name: In-place word swap
techniques.what: The line holds and one word is replaced where it stands.
techniques.route: RasanTypeOnly.swap(tl, slotEl, ['fast', 'safe', 'yours'], {at, every: 0.7}); the slot width follows (0.3 s power3.inOut).

techniques.name: Word drum
techniques.what: A column of words rolls past a window like a slot machine, landing on the right one.
techniques.route: RasanTypeOnly.drum(tl, hostEl, words, {at, every: 0.55, rows: 5}); finish on the target word (steps = target index).

techniques.name: Sentence ladder
techniques.what: Each rung repeats the refrain and adds a word, older rungs dim as new ones climb in.
techniques.route: RasanTypeOnly.ladder(tl, stage, ['We make it.', 'We make it fast.', 'We make it fast for you.'], {at, every: 1}).

techniques.name: Colour flip
techniques.what: Ground and ink swap on the beat, a one-frame change of mood.
techniques.route: tl.set(stage, {background: c}, t) and tl.set(text, {color: ink}, t) on the cut; no fade.

techniques.name: Outline to fill
techniques.what: A word starts as an outline and fills with colour as it is said.

techniques.name: Mask reveal up
techniques.what: A word rises out of an invisible baseline.

techniques.name: Word choreography
techniques.what: Each word of a line enters from its own place and settles into the line with a lift; the key word last with a little more overshoot.
techniques.route: RasanShape.split(el, {by: 'words'}); each word from its own offset 24 to 80 px, scale 0.88 to 1.15, blur 6 to 12 px to rest, 0.55 s, stagger 0.09 s, last word back.out(1.4); the next line starts 0.2 s before this one settles.

signature: The refrain returns one last time with the product's name as the changed word, and the frame holds on that whole line for a beat.

density.note: A new word, swap or crop every 0.35 to 0.8 s; 1 to 4 words per beat; layers at the peak: 2 to 4 (field, hero word, support line, mark).

palette.note: A brand palette supplies 2 to 3 field colours and one ink; the type stays one family.

do: Keep 1 to 4 words per beat and land them on the voice
Hold one repeated phrase as the film's spine
Flip the field colour on the beat
Swap words in place so the line never leaves
Make crops motion states that resolve to a whole word
dont: Do not fill a beat with a sentence of body copy
Do not mix more than one typeface family
Do not crop a word that is held at rest
Do not add decoration to carry the film; type is the actor
